tools.name: st_alerts_list
tools.description: List bounded owner alerts with actionable question/options, episode, target and evidence when present. Set agent_id to an exact canonical agent ID to select its published alerts. An empty page does not mean no work. Use st_alert_get only when further exact detail is needed.

agent_id.description: Exact canonical agent ID, not an alias or display name.

tools.name: st_alert_get
tools.description: Read one exact owner alert, including its episode and named answer options.

tools.name: st_alert_answer
tools.description: Execute one typed person-ask answer under write.assistant.answers using the alert's current episode and fence.

action_id.description: Unique per intended action, e.g. action/<short-slug>; reuse the same value on a retry

fence.description: Use the snapshot returned by the preceding read. Copy subject revisions from that snapshot to fence writes against changed resources.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot id from the immediately preceding read result.

subject_revisions.description: Resource subject identifiers mapped to their opaque revision strings; omitted means no subject-specific revisions.

idempotency_key.description: 16-256 printable ASCII chars only (stricter than daemon byte-length bounds); reuse the exact value on retries of the same action

tools.name: st_agents_list
tools.description: List agent metadata. For a known canonical agent ID, set agent_id to avoid paging through the fleet. This does not read priorities or conversation content.

agent_id.description: Exact canonical agent ID, not an alias or display name.

tools.name: st_conversations_list
tools.description: Discover source-bounded conversation metadata and read handles without conversation content. Each value.items entry supplies agent_id and session_id for st_conversation_timeline and a read object containing all st_conversation_read arguments (null when the bounded current timeline page has no readable text handle; use timeline to continue). Pass read unchanged to st_conversation_read; use value.page.next_cursor to page this list. Pages fit max_response_bytes; an item that cannot fit alone is named in the error.

tools.name: st_conversation_detail
tools.description: Read one agent's current conversation with bounded chat excerpts and revision-pinned read handles. Use agent_id from st_conversations_list; pass each non-null timeline item's read object unchanged to st_conversation_read. Content may be sensitive.

tools.name: st_conversation_timeline
tools.description: Page bounded chat excerpts and revision-pinned read handles. Copy agent_id and session_id from st_conversations_list to select the discovered session; omit session_id only to select the current session. Pass each non-null value.items[].read object unchanged to st_conversation_read, and use value.page.next_cursor only to continue this timeline. Content may be sensitive.

cursor.description: Copy value.page.next_cursor from the preceding timeline page; omit for the first page.

session_id.description: Copy the same conversation item's session_id to pin the discovered session; omitted selects the current session.

tools.name: st_conversation_search
tools.description: Search bounded plain conversation text snippets. Content may be sensitive.

tools.name: st_conversation_read
tools.description: Read one bounded revision-pinned conversation content range. Pass a non-null value.items[].read object from st_conversations_list or st_conversation_timeline unchanged; conversation detail also supplies timeline read handles. Each read object contains agent_id, session_id, reference, revision, start and end. Never invent handles or substitute a pagination cursor for a content reference. Content may contain sensitive material.

agent_id.description: Copy read.agent_id from a discovered conversation or timeline item.

end.description: Copy read.end, the exclusive range end.

reference.description: Copy read.reference, an opaque content reference, not a pagination cursor.

revision.description: Copy read.revision paired with this content reference to pin the source version.

session_id.description: Copy read.session_id from the same handle; do not infer from agent_id.

start.description: Copy read.start, the inclusive range start.

tools.name: st_message_send
tools.description: Send one exact message to any existing agent, authorized by write.assistant.messages and the ChatGPT confirmation card. Person recipients are refused.

action_id.description: Unique per intended action, e.g. action/<short-slug>; reuse the same value on a retry

fence.description: Use the snapshot returned by the preceding read. Copy subject revisions from that snapshot to fence writes against changed resources.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot id from the immediately preceding read result.

subject_revisions.description: Resource subject identifiers mapped to their opaque revision strings; omitted means no subject-specific revisions.
